sentences.english: I usually go on foot.
sentences.chinese: 我通常步行去。
sentences.scene: 朋友问你怎么去附近的超市，你指指自己的运动鞋。

sentences.english: It's such a beautiful evening; let's go to the restaurant on foot.
sentences.chinese: 今晚天气真好，我们步行去那家餐厅吧。
sentences.scene: 晚饭后，你不想开车，拉着伴侣的手提议散步过去。

sentences.english: Since the bus was late and the sun was finally out, we decided to go to the office on foot. It took longer, but we passed a lovely bakery and got fresh croissants.
sentences.chinese: 因为公交车迟迟不来，太阳又终于出来了，我们决定步行去公司。虽然花的时间更长，但路过一家可爱的面包店，还买了新鲜的可颂。
sentences.scene: 在公交站等车等得不耐烦，干脆走路，意外收获了小确幸。

sentences.english: I go to school by bus.
sentences.chinese: 我乘公交车去上学。
sentences.scene: 开学第一天，老师让大家轮流介绍出行方式。

sentences.english: Would you rather travel by train or by plane?
sentences.chinese: 你想坐火车还是坐飞机旅行？
sentences.scene: 规划假期时，你拿着两个方案跟旅伴商量。

sentences.english: When I lived in New York, I went everywhere by subway because driving was way too slow and finding a parking spot was a total nightmare.
sentences.chinese: 我住在纽约的时候，去哪儿都坐地铁，因为开车实在太慢了，找个停车位简直是噩梦。
sentences.scene: 和朋友聊起大城市的生活体验，回忆起被停车支配的恐惧。

sentences.english: The bus is late again.
sentences.chinese: 公交车又晚点了。
sentences.scene: 你站在站台上看手表，无奈地对旁边的乘客抱怨。

sentences.english: I missed the bus this morning and had to run all the way to work.
sentences.chinese: 我今天早上没赶上公交，只能一路跑到公司。
sentences.scene: 你气喘吁吁地冲进办公室，跟同事解释为什么满头大汗。

sentences.english: On the bus ride home, I sat next to an old man who started telling me stories about his childhood. It was the most interesting conversation I've ever had on a bus.
sentences.chinese: 在回家的公交车上，我坐在一位老人旁边，他开始给我讲他童年的故事。这是我在公交车上最有趣的一次对话。
sentences.scene: 你原本打算刷手机，却被邻座老人的故事深深吸引，一直听到到站。

sentences.english: The plane takes off at six.
sentences.chinese: 飞机六点起飞。
sentences.scene: 你看着登机牌上的时间，提醒同伴别逛免税店了。

sentences.english: I'm a little nervous about flying. This is my first time on a plane.
sentences.chinese: 我对坐飞机有点紧张。这是我第一次。
sentences.scene: 在候机厅，你紧握着扶手，小声告诉旁边的朋友。

sentences.english: The plane was shaking a bit because of the storm, and I was totally scared. But the flight attendant was so calm that it helped me relax, and we landed safely.
sentences.chinese: 因为暴风雨，飞机有点颠簸，我吓坏了。但乘务员非常冷静，这帮我放松了下来，最后我们安全降落了。
sentences.scene: 遭遇气流，你吓得抓紧座位，看到乘务员微笑的表情才松了口气。

sentences.english: Let's take a taxi home.
sentences.chinese: 我们打车回家吧。
sentences.scene: 看完演唱会出来夜深了，你招手拦了一辆车。

sentences.english: I called a taxi, but it's stuck in traffic. We might be late.
sentences.chinese: 我叫了辆出租车，但它堵在路上了。我们可能会迟到。
sentences.scene: 你焦急地看着打车软件上原地不动的车辆图标，对朋友说。

sentences.english: The taxi driver was so friendly and funny. He told us jokes the whole ride, and by the time we got to the hotel, I was in such a great mood.
sentences.chinese: 那位出租车司机既友好又风趣。他一路上都在给我们讲笑话，等到了酒店时，我的心情超级好。
sentences.scene: 旅行第一天，遇到一个特别能侃的的哥，让原本疲惫的行程变得开心。

sentences.english: The ship is really big.
sentences.chinese: 这艘船真大。
sentences.scene: 你站在码头上，抬头仰望面前巨大的邮轮，发出惊叹。

sentences.english: We took a ship to the island for our vacation. The weather was perfect.
sentences.chinese: 我们乘船去那个岛上度假。天气完美极了。
sentences.scene: 你站在甲板上吹着海风，看着渐渐靠近的小岛，兴奋地拍照。

sentences.english: My grandfather worked on a ship for many years. He told me stories about sailing through storms and visiting countries I can only dream of.
sentences.chinese: 我的祖父在船上工作了很多年。他给我讲在暴风雨中航行、去那些我梦寐以求的国家的故事。
sentences.scene: 客厅里，祖父翻出泛黄的老照片，你坐在他脚边听得入迷。

sentences.english: I take the subway to work.
sentences.chinese: 我坐地铁去上班。
sentences.scene: 早上在电梯里，邻居问你通勤方式，你随口回答。

sentences.english: The subway is usually faster than the bus during rush hour.
sentences.chinese: 高峰时段，地铁通常比公交车快。
sentences.scene: 朋友犹豫坐什么车，你果断拉着他往地铁站走。

sentences.english: I love people-watching on the subway. You see all kinds of people — students, business people, musicians — and it reminds me that everyone has their own story.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢在地铁上观察人群。你能看到形形色色的人——学生、上班族、音乐家——这提醒我每个人都有自己的故事。
sentences.scene: 你靠在车厢角落里，看着来来往往的乘客，思绪万千。

sentences.english: I like traveling by train.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢坐火车旅行。
sentences.scene: 和朋友讨论假期怎么去远方，你表达了对火车窗景的热爱。

sentences.english: The train leaves at 7 a.m., so we need to get up really early.
sentences.chinese: 火车早上7点出发，所以我们得特别早起床。
sentences.scene: 睡前你设定闹钟，提醒同伴明天可不能赖床。

sentences.english: Taking the overnight train saved us money on a hotel, and waking up to see the sun rising over the mountains was absolutely breathtaking.
sentences.chinese: 坐夜班火车省下了住酒店的钱，而且醒来时看到日出在山峦上方升起，真是美得令人窒息。
sentences.scene: 你拉开卧铺窗帘，眼前的美景让你瞬间清醒，觉得这个选择太明智了。

sentences.english: The internet is slow today.
sentences.chinese: 今天网速很慢。
sentences.scene: 视频会议卡住了，你烦躁地刷新网页，自言自语。

sentences.english: The service at this restaurant is really slow. We've been waiting for 30 minutes.
sentences.chinese: 这家餐厅上菜可真慢。我们已经等了30分钟了。
sentences.scene: 你看着空空的桌子，招手催服务员，然后跟同伴吐槽。

sentences.english: I'm a slow reader, so it takes me forever to finish a novel. But I enjoy taking my time and really imagining the story in my head.
sentences.chinese: 我读书很慢，所以花好长时间才能看完一本小说。但我享受慢慢读，在大脑里好好想象故事情节。
sentences.scene: 朋友惊讶你一本书读那么久，你解释自己的阅读习惯。

sentences.english: He walked down the stairs.
sentences.chinese: 他走下了楼梯。
sentences.scene: 你听到脚步声，抬头看到室友慢慢走下楼来。

sentences.english: Can you write down your phone number for me?
sentences.chinese: 你能把你的电话号码写下来给我吗？
sentences.scene: 在聚会上认识新朋友，你掏出手机让他输入号码。

sentences.english: I was walking down the street when I found a lost puppy. It looked so scared that I sat down on the sidewalk, and it came right to me.
sentences.chinese: 我正沿着街走，突然发现一只走失的小狗。它看起来很害怕，于是我坐在人行道上，它立刻朝我跑来了。
sentences.scene: 傍晚散步，你偶然捡到一只小狗，温柔地安抚它。

sentences.english: Slow down, you're driving too fast.
sentences.chinese: 慢一点，你开得太快了。
sentences.scene: 坐在副驾驶的家人紧张地抓着扶手，提醒司机。

sentences.english: My doctor told me to slow down and not work so hard.
sentences.chinese: 医生叫我放慢节奏，别那么拼命工作。
sentences.scene: 体检后，你向朋友转述医生的忠告，思考如何平衡生活。

sentences.english: I used to rush through my meals, but recently I've been trying to slow down and actually taste my food. It's amazing how much better everything seems.
sentences.chinese: 我以前总狼吞虎咽，但最近我试着放慢速度，真正去品尝食物。这样做好像一切都变得更美好了，真的很神奇。
sentences.scene: 你慢慢嚼着一口菜，跟对面的朋友分享这个改变带来的惊喜。

sentences.english: Please stop the car here.
sentences.chinese: 请在这里停车。
sentences.scene: 到了超市门口，你拍拍司机的肩膀示意靠边停下。

sentences.english: I really need to stop staying up so late on work nights.
sentences.chinese: 我真的不能再在工作日晚上熬夜了。
sentences.scene: 早上对着镜子看黑眼圈，你发誓今晚一定要早睡。

sentences.english: It took me a while to realize that nobody is perfect. Once I stopped being so hard on myself, I started enjoying life a lot more.
sentences.chinese: 我花了好一阵子才明白人无完人。一旦我不再那么苛责自己，我就开始更享受生活了。
sentences.scene: 和朋友聊起曾经的完美主义，你感叹释怀后的轻松。

sentences.english: Mrs. Smith is my English teacher.
sentences.chinese: 史密斯太太是我的英语老师。
sentences.scene: 开学自我介绍，你提到最喜欢的老师。

sentences.english: Our next-door neighbor, Mrs. Johnson, has the most beautiful garden on the street.
sentences.chinese: 我们的隔壁邻居，约翰逊太太，有这条街上最漂亮的花园。
sentences.scene: 你趴在篱笆上看邻居阿姨在修剪玫瑰，跟家人赞叹。

sentences.english: When I was a kid, there was a kind lady named Mrs. Davis who ran the local library. She always remembered which books I liked and would save them for me.
sentences.chinese: 我小时候，有一位名叫戴维斯太太的善良女士经营着本地图书馆。她总记得我喜欢什么书，会特地留给我。
sentences.scene: 你回到老家，路过旧图书馆，回忆起那位温暖的管理员。

sentences.english: I woke up early today.
sentences.chinese: 我今天醒得很早。
sentences.scene: 你伸着懒腰走进厨房，爸妈惊讶你怎么起这么早。

sentences.english: Let's leave early to avoid the morning traffic.
sentences.chinese: 我们早点出发，避开早高峰。
sentences.scene: 看着窗外开始堵车的迹象，你提议马上动身。

sentences.english: I'm not normally an early riser, but there's something special about getting up early on vacation — the city is so quiet, and you have the whole day ahead of you.
sentences.chinese: 我通常不喜欢早起，但度假时早起有种特别的感觉——城市很安静，而且一整天都等着你去享受。
sentences.scene: 旅行时，你穿着睡衣站在阳台上，看着还没睡醒的街道，心情大好。

sentences.english: Wear your helmet when biking.
sentences.chinese: 骑自行车要戴头盔。
sentences.scene: 孩子冲出家门要骑车，妈妈在后面大声叮嘱。

sentences.english: My dad bought me a cool new bike helmet for my birthday.
sentences.chinese: 爸爸给我买了一个很酷的新自行车头盔作为生日礼物。
sentences.scene: 你拆开礼物，开心地把头盔戴在头上，尺寸刚刚好。

sentences.english: I had a bike accident last year, and my helmet literally saved my life. Ever since then, I never ride without it, no matter how short the trip is.
sentences.chinese: 我去年骑车出了事故，我的头盔真的救了我一命。从那以后，不管路程多短，我骑车一定会戴它。
sentences.scene: 你指着旧头盔上的裂痕，严肃地告诫刚学骑车的小表弟。

sentences.english: You must wear a seatbelt.
sentences.chinese: 你必须系好安全带。
sentences.scene: 一上车，你就提醒后座的朋友，安全第一。

sentences.english: We must finish this report by Friday, or the boss will be very unhappy.
sentences.chinese: 我们必须周五前完成这份报告，不然老板会很不高兴的。
sentences.scene: 小组会议上，组长严肃地看着大家，强调了最后期限。

sentences.english: When I was in school, I thought I must become a doctor or a lawyer to be successful. Now I know that you must find a path that makes you happy, not just rich.
sentences.chinese: 上学时，我以为必须成为医生或律师才算成功。现在我知道，你必须找到一条让你幸福的路，而不只是挣钱的路。
sentences.scene: 深夜和老友聊天，你感慨过去对成功的误解。

sentences.english: What should I wear today?
sentences.chinese: 我今天该穿什么？
sentences.scene: 你盯着衣柜发愁，向室友求助。

sentences.english: I always wear comfortable shoes when I travel, because you walk a lot.
sentences.chinese: 我旅行时总是穿舒适的鞋子，因为要走很多路。
sentences.scene: 打包行李时，你果断放弃了那双好看但磨脚的新鞋。

sentences.english: For the interview, I decided to wear my lucky blue shirt. I know it sounds silly, but it gave me confidence, and I ended up getting the job.
sentences.chinese: 面试时，我决定穿上我的幸运蓝衬衫。我知道这听起来傻傻的，但它给了我信心，最后我拿到了那份工作。
sentences.scene: 你整理着衣领，跟朋友分享这个小迷信，脸上洋溢着成功的喜悦。

sentences.english: May I have your attention, please?
sentences.chinese: 请大家注意一下。
sentences.scene: 婚礼主持人敲了敲酒杯，示意宾客安静。

sentences.english: The teacher asked for our attention before she started the math lesson.
sentences.chinese: 老师开始上数学课前，让大家集中注意力。
sentences.scene: 闹哄哄的教室里，老师拍了拍手，大家立刻安静下来。

sentences.english: My cat does the funniest thing to get my attention when I'm working — she jumps onto the keyboard and just sits there, staring at me until I pet her.
sentences.chinese: 我工作时，我家猫为了引起我的注意，会做出最好笑的事——跳到键盘上，就坐在那儿盯着我，直到我摸摸它。
sentences.scene: 你对着电脑屏幕加班，主子突然趴在你手边求关注。

sentences.english: Pay attention to the road, please.
sentences.chinese: 请注意看路。
sentences.scene: 你开车时看了眼手机，旁边的朋友立刻提醒你。

sentences.english: You should really pay attention to what the tour guide is saying. It's very interesting.
sentences.chinese: 你真的应该认真听导游在讲什么。特别有意思。
sentences.scene: 大家都在听讲解，就你在自拍，同伴用胳膊肘捅了捅你。

sentences.english: Growing up, my mom always told me to pay attention to the little things in life, like a beautiful sunset or a stranger's smile, because they can brighten your whole day.
sentences.chinese: 从小到大，妈妈总告诉我要留意生活中的小事，比如美丽的夕阳或陌生人的微笑，因为这些能点亮你的一整天。
sentences.scene: 你看着天边的晚霞，给朋友发消息分享妈妈的这句人生哲理。

sentences.english: The traffic is really bad today.
sentences.chinese: 今天的交通真是太堵了。
sentences.scene: 你堵在高架桥上纹丝不动，打电话给家人说要晚点到。

sentences.english: I'm always late for work because of the heavy traffic on the freeway.
sentences.chinese: 我总是因为高速公路堵车而上班迟到。
sentences.scene: 你垂头丧气地溜进工位，跟同事解释又是堵车惹的祸。

sentences.english: I left two hours early, but the traffic was so insane that I nearly missed my flight. I was the last person on the plane, sweating and out of breath.
sentences.chinese: 我提前两小时就出门了，但交通堵得一塌糊涂，差点误了飞机。我是最后一个登机的，满头大汗，气喘吁吁。
sentences.scene: 你瘫坐在座位上，回想刚才在机场一路狂奔的惊险时刻。

sentences.english: The traffic lights aren't working.
sentences.chinese: 红绿灯坏了。
sentences.scene: 你看着路口闪烁的黄灯，提醒过马路的同伴小心。

sentences.english: Turn left at the next traffic lights, and you'll see the store.
sentences.chinese: 在下一个红绿灯左转，你就能看到那家店了。
sentences.scene: 你电话指挥开车迷路的朋友，描述明显的标志。

sentences.english: I was rushing to a meeting when the traffic lights turned red. While waiting, I saw a little girl helping an old lady cross the street, and it totally made my day.
sentences.chinese: 我赶着去开会，红绿灯变红了。在等的时候，我看到一个小女孩扶着老奶奶过马路，那一幕完全点亮了我的一天。
sentences.scene: 你坐在车里等红灯，看到窗外暖心的一幕，会也不觉得急了。

sentences.english: I want to visit Munich someday.
sentences.chinese: 我希望有一天能去慕尼黑。
sentences.scene: 你翻着旅游杂志，指着慕尼黑啤酒节的照片对朋友说。

sentences.english: My cousin is studying engineering in Munich this semester.
sentences.chinese: 我表哥这学期在慕尼黑读工程学。
sentences.scene: 家人聚会上，你向大家汇报这位留学生的近况。

sentences.english: We spent Christmas in Munich last year, walking through the snowy markets with mugs of hot chocolate. It felt like being inside a holiday movie.
sentences.chinese: 去年我们在慕尼黑过的圣诞，端着热巧克力在雪中逛集市。感觉就像活在一部节日电影里。
sentences.scene: 你看着照片里灯火璀璨的木屋和雪花，回味那个童话般的假期。

sentences.english: She moved to Germany last year.
sentences.chinese: 她去年搬去德国了。
sentences.scene: 翻看朋友圈，你告诉旁边的朋友一位老同学的去向。

sentences.english: I tried real German bread when I was in Germany, and it was so different.
sentences.chinese: 我在德国时尝了真正的德国面包，跟这里的太不一样了。
sentences.scene: 在一家德式面包店里，你回忆旅程，跟店员夸赞。

sentences.english: My dream is to drive through the countryside in Germany, stopping at small villages and castles along the way. I've heard the views are absolutely stunning.
sentences.chinese: 我的梦想是在德国的乡间驾车，沿途在那些小村庄和城堡停留。听说那里的景色美得惊人。
sentences.scene: 你盯着电脑壁纸上的新天鹅堡，跟室友描绘心中的完美旅行。

sentences.english: Alaska is very cold in winter.
sentences.chinese: 阿拉斯加冬天非常冷。
sentences.scene: 电视里播放阿拉斯加冰天雪地的画面，你裹紧毯子感叹。

sentences.english: We went to Alaska to see the Northern Lights. It was a magical experience.
sentences.chinese: 我们去阿拉斯加看北极光了。那是一次不可思议的体验。
sentences.scene: 你向同事展示手机里绚烂的极光照片，对方羡慕不已。

sentences.english: Living in Alaska taught me to appreciate nature in a completely new way. The summer days are so long, and the silence of the snowy forests is something you can't find anywhere else.
sentences.chinese: 在阿拉斯加生活让我学会了用一种全新的方式欣赏大自然。夏天的白昼很长，雪林中那份宁静在别处找不到。
sentences.scene: 与远方的老友视频，你聊起在那里的生活如何改变了你。

sentences.english: The kids love the new sled.
sentences.chinese: 孩子们很喜欢这个新雪橇。
sentences.scene: 你看着孩子们在雪地里拖着新玩具，兴奋地尖叫。

sentences.english: We took the sled to the top of the hill and slid down laughing.
sentences.chinese: 我们把雪橇拉到山顶，然后大笑着滑下来。
sentences.scene: 雪后初晴，你和朋友们在公园的山坡上来回奔跑滑雪橇。

sentences.english: On snow days, my dad would pull my sister and me on the sled through our neighborhood. I still remember holding on tight and the sound of his boots crunching in the snow.
sentences.chinese: 下雪天，爸爸会拉着雪橇带我妹妹和我在小区里走。我至今记得紧紧抓着雪橇，耳边是爸爸靴子踩雪的嘎吱声。
sentences.scene: 看着窗外飘雪，你回忆起童年时父亲在雪中拉雪橇的温馨画面。

sentences.english: The train goes really fast.
sentences.chinese: 这列火车开得真快。
sentences.scene: 你坐在靠窗的座位，看着窗外的景物飞速后退。

sentences.english: She types so fast that I can hardly keep up with what she's saying.
sentences.chinese: 她打字太快了，我几乎跟不上她在说什么。
sentences.scene: 开线上会议，看同事敲键盘的速度，你在屏幕这边目瞪口呆。

sentences.english: Childhood goes by so fast. One moment you're teaching them to walk, and the next they're packing bags for college. It really makes you want to enjoy every moment.
sentences.chinese: 童年过得太快了。刚刚还在教他们走路，一转眼他们就打包准备上大学了。这真的让你想珍惜每一刻。
sentences.scene: 翻到孩子小时候的照片，你眼眶微红，对另一半感慨时光飞逝。

sentences.english: We took the ferry to the island.
sentences.chinese: 我们坐渡轮去了岛上。
sentences.scene: 你站在码头上，指着远处缓缓靠岸的白色大船。

sentences.english: The ferry ride was so beautiful. The wind was perfect, and we saw dolphins.
sentences.chinese: 坐渡轮的过程真美。风恰到好处，我们还看到了海豚。
sentences.scene: 你在甲板上兴奋地指着跃出水面的海豚，让大家快看。

sentences.english: I used to take the ferry to work every morning when I lived on the coast. It was such a calm way to start the day, just standing on deck with a cup of coffee watching the water.
sentences.chinese: 住在海岸时，我以前每天早上坐渡轮上班。那是一种非常平静的开启一天的方式，就站在甲板上，端着一杯咖啡看着水面。
sentences.scene: 虽然早已搬离，但看到渡轮的照片，那段通勤时光的美好仍然记忆犹新。

sentences.english: Papa Westray is a tiny island in Scotland.
sentences.chinese: 帕帕韦斯特雷是苏格兰的一个小岛。
sentences.scene: 你看着地图上几乎看不见的小点，好奇地向同伴指出来。

sentences.english: Have you heard of Papa Westray? It's famous for the world's shortest flight.
sentences.chinese: 你听说过帕帕韦斯特雷岛吗？它以世界上最短的飞行闻名。
sentences.scene: 在酒吧和朋友聊冷知识，你打开手机查这个奇怪的地名。

sentences.english: Last summer, I actually went to Papa Westray. The flight was less than two minutes, and the island was so peaceful — just green hills, cliffs, and the sound of the sea.
sentences.chinese: 去年夏天，我真去了帕帕韦斯特雷岛。飞行时间不到两分钟，岛上特别宁静——只有绿色的山丘、悬崖和海浪声。
sentences.scene: 你翻着相册里岛上空旷的美景，给朋友看那趟独特的旅行记录。

sentences.english: Scotland is famous for its castles.
sentences.chinese: 苏格兰以城堡闻名。
sentences.scene: 电视上出现一座古堡，你随口说出这句话。

sentences.english: We visited Scotland last summer and fell in love with the highlands.
sentences.chinese: 去年夏天我们去了苏格兰，并爱上了那里的高地风光。
sentences.scene: 你向朋友展示在苏格兰高地拍的连绵山脉和湖泊的照片。

sentences.english: My grandmother was from Scotland, and she used to tell us stories about growing up near Loch Lomond. Her tales made me want to visit so badly, and when I finally went, it felt like coming home.
sentences.chinese: 我祖母是苏格兰人，她常给我们讲她在洛蒙德湖附近长大的故事。她的故事让我特别想去，当我终于去了，感觉就像回家一样。
sentences.scene: 你站在湖边，想象祖母小时候也在同一个地方玩耍，内心充满感动。
